security_fix.title: fix(web): only DANGEROUSLY_OMIT_AUTH=true/1 disables /api auth
security_fix.upstream_statement: buildWebServerConfigFromEnv read the flag as !!process.env.DANGEROUSLY_OMIT_AUTH, so every non-empty string, including false and 0, turned the /api/* bearer gate off
security_fix.shipped_code: stage/auth-parse-source.txt: 2.7.0 clients/web/build/index.js:1661 `!!process.env.DANGEROUSLY_OMIT_AUTH`; 2.8.0 :1669 `isEnvFlagEnabled(process.env.DANGEROUSLY_OMIT_AUTH)` (trimmed, lower-cased, true or 1 only)

upstream.other_changes_read: release body: Mcp-Method stamped on modern-era notification POSTs (#2392), OIDC body release (#2393), local $ref resolution before form widgets (#2391), per-server setting to suppress the standalone GET notification stream (#2394), MCP_INSPECTOR_SECRET_KEY_FILE (#2448), project LICENSE (#2449), docs and skills changes

harness.isolation: every arm ran through sandbox.sh: bwrap with a private network namespace (loopback only, so no web or HTTP listener was reachable from the host and no host port was used), / read-only, /mnt hidden (no Windows executable or browser can start), HOME and TMPDIR inside the arm directory, MCP_AUTO_OPEN_ENABLED=false
harness.fixture: a project-local QMD index (`qmd init`) over one Markdown file holding a random marker; QMD 2.8.3 from the host's bin/qmd
harness.never_run: `mcp-inspector --version` or a bare `mcp-inspector`; web mode ran only as the explicit `--web` A8 probe inside the sandbox

attempts.result: harness error before any Inspector call: the sandbox hides /tmp, so the harness path outside the arm directory was not visible (python3: can't open file); both arms rerun with the harness copied into the arm

A1 qmd init, collection add, update (fixture)

web_auth_gate.2.7.0: off (no token needed, wrong token accepted) for false, 0 and yes as well as true; banner 'Auth: disabled (DANGEROUSLY_OMIT_AUTH)'
web_auth_gate.2.8.0: on (401 without or with a wrong token, 200 with the right one) for unset, false, 0 and yes; off only for true
web_auth_gate.unchanged: unset: on in both; true: off in both; no 'Opening browser' line in any start

production_untouched_during_qualificatio: the qualification used only the new prefix, the retained 2.7.0 prefix and sandboxed scratch directories; bin/mcp-inspector still named 2.7.0 until the switch

switch.preconditions: no running mcp-inspector process (a /proc scan by executable and argv); no reference to the 2.7.0 prefix path in ~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.codex/config.toml, systemd user units or the crontab, so only the bin link selects the version
switch.post_switch: postswitch.sh through the PATH entry (CLI only): resolves to tools/mcp-inspector-2.8.0, npm ls 2.8.0, qmd 2.8.3, tools/list OK, tools/call query OK, unknown tool exit 5 tool_not_found, ALL CHECKS PASSED (cutover/postswitch.out)
switch.rollback: ln -sfn ~/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/mcp-inspector-2.7.0/bin/mcp-inspector ~/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/bin/.mcp-inspector.new && mv -T ~/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/bin/.mcp-inspector.new ~/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/bin/mcp-inspector; the Inspector keeps no store that 2.8.0 migrates
